from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BRIDGE = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py'
DISPATCHER = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_dispatcher.py'
WORKER = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_worker.sh'


def test_bridge_supports_explicit_base_policy():
    text = BRIDGE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'current_at_execution' in text
    assert 'BASE_SHA_REQUIRED_FOR_EXACT_POLICY' in text
    assert 'INVALID_BASE_POLICY' in text


def test_dispatcher_binds_current_policy_at_execution_time():
    text = DISPATCHER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'base_policy = str(job.get("base_policy")' in text
    assert 'base_sha = current_dev' in text
    assert 'result["base_policy"] = base_policy' in text
    assert 'BASE_SHA_MISMATCH' in text


def test_execution_remains_serialized_even_when_intake_is_multi_job():
    text = DISPATCHER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'dispatcher.lock' in text
    worker = WORKER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'UNIVERSAL_WORKER_LOOP_SECONDS:-10' in worker
